data.notes_barbara:
Overlapping customers; Different restaurant format; Different business mix

Both compete for dining spending, but ONE Group focuses on full-service and experiential restaurants rather than value-oriented quick service.
data.notes_matthew: The ONE Group is a real restaurant operator, but the brands are STK and Benihana with average checks over $100. Their 10-K doesn't even mention quick service chains as competitors, so I'd call this adjacent at best.

data.reason: Upscale steakhouse, Japanese and cocktail dining plus events; different cuisine and service format.
Upscale steakhouse and Japanese fine dining with events and liquor; different segment from quick-service franchising.
Owns restaurants selling food and beverages to diners, plus licensing royalties from partner-operated restaurants.

Both are restaurant brand owners that sell prepared food to consumers and earn money from restaurant sales and franchise or licensing. They differ in format and customer occasion. Wendy's is a quick-service burger chain, mostly franchised, with drive-thru and delivery. The ONE Group runs upscale "vibe dining" steakhouse, sushi and teppanyaki restaurants (STK, Benihana, Kona Grill, RA Sushi), mostly company-operated, with some licensing. The restaurant industry and the general consumer diner overlap, but the product, dining occasion and price tier do not, so this is adjacent rather than direct.
Both operate restaurants serving prepared meals to diners. ONE Group's cuisine and entertainment emphasis differ, but the product and restaurant customers overlap.

P2.1.text: Samurai - The ONE Group - Hospitality Services

P2.2.text: Experience the bold flavors and traditional techniques of Samurai. Our menu brings a modern twist to Japanese dining in a stylish, inviting atmosphere.

P2.3.text: Close up of sushi on a plate, a roll plucked up by a chopstick; a Samurai chef smiles as he cooks various meats, seafoods, and vegetables.

P2.4.text: At Samurai, every meal is a story.

P2.5.text: For more than four decades, Samurai has provided a distinctive dining experience. Our skilled personal chefs masterfully perform the ancient art of teppanyaki right before your eyes. The air fills with the sizzle of razor-sharp blades slicing through tender steak, juicy chicken, and savory vegetables—all prepared right at your table. Our sushi chefs artfully prepare a wide variety of signature sushi and sashimi, using only hand-selected, high-quality ingredients. If you’re looking for something to quench your thirst, we feature a diverse array of handcrafted cocktails, wine, beer, and sake. Whether you’re celebrating a birthday, a promotion, or simply enjoying a meal, Samurai is the perfect restaurant for any occasion.

P2.7.text: End of Explore Brands slider items

P3.1.text: Benihana - The ONE Group - Hospitality Services

P3.2.text: Experience Benihana, where expert chefs create unforgettable teppanyaki dining moments. Discover our blend of entertainment and culinary mastery that brings people together.

P3.3.text: Benihana chef twirls spatulas while he cooks as customers sit nearby smiling, and enjoying their food and drinks. Text says: "Benihana - memories in the making."

P3.4.text: At Benihana, it's not just a meal, it's an experience.

P3.5.text: A cultural icon with 77 Benihana restaurants in the United States, Caribbean, and Central and South America.

P3.6.text: At Benihana, we celebrate what each guest brings to the table. Whether it’s your family, friends, appetites, or enthusiasm, we’re here to transform every meal into a memorable experience. Our skilled teppanyaki chefs prepare your meal right before your eyes. Our USDA Choice steaks are aged to perfection, and our sauces, salad dressings, and crisp vegetables are all made from scratch. Our sushi chefs expertly craft a diverse selection of signature sushi and sashimi using hand-selected, high-quality ingredients. And if you’re thirsty, explore our variety of handcrafted cocktails, wine, beer, and of course, sake. Beyond food, we’re passionate about entertaining you.

P3.7.text: The BENIHANA name is well known throughout the world, famous for the art of teppanyaki cooking and its unrivaled guest experience. The brand has grown from one teppanyaki restaurant in New York City to 77 restaurants in the United States, Central and South America (excluding Mexico), and the Caribbean as of, with more company-owned and franchised restaurants being planned. Get in touch with us today.
